purpose: Separate the latest current-source ReferenceCanvas/Observation/Primary Form cohort from older CADFit transport, retained historical observation, and isolated Boolean/ActionRun/restart receipts.

current_multiview_primary_form_transport.objective_scope: ReferenceCanvas binds six views and Runtime PrimaryFormMultiViewEvaluation@1 evaluates all six with inferred cameras; the proposal improves right/perspective but regresses front/back/left/rear-three-quarter, so retained_source is the correct fail-closed result. This is multi-view acceptance/veto evidence, not an HQ likeness pass; joint multi-view search remains the next optimization boundary.

boolean_source_gate.scope: same-Part bounded union/difference/intersection; not general mesh Boolean

boolean_adoption_gate.cohort_binding: historical isolated adoption receipt; not promoted to current source cohort

checks.meshgl_topology_readback: PASS: finite vertices, triangle index bounds, positive volumes, face IDs and two source runs read back
checks.determinism: PASS: same-process and separate-process MeshGL64 fingerprints matched for all three operations
checks.resource_timeout_crash_fd: PASS: 3,496-triangle bounded stress case; CPU=5s, nofile=64, core=0; ASan/UBSan pass; FD 3->3
checks.negative_input: PASS: invalid index and non-finite vertex fail with non-zero Manifold status without crash
checks.removal_fallback: PASS: product integration is isolated to the Worker build/allowlist/catalog slice; removing that slice leaves the prior product-owned geometry path and fail-closed Boolean contract
checks.negative_boolean_gate: PASS: forgecad.geometry.boolean@1 accepts only union/difference; intersection, wrong arity and non-finite/index-invalid inputs fail closed

action_run_quality_gate.wording_boundary: direct Repair probe blocked; ActionRun-bound CADFit child proposal materialized for visual review but failed quality gate

runtime_parameter_patch_unit_gate.scope: ephemeral primitive@2 shell Part fixture; one bounded shell-width parameter change

runtime_parameter_patch_real_reference_p.reason: The supplied attachment was a ForgeCAD UI screenshot rather than the historical robot reference; retain as diagnostic transport evidence, not visual-quality evidence.
